svg.text: Bovine calibration: what the measurements constrain
37°C · 1% oscillatory shear · storage G′ (blue) and loss G″ (orange)
Dots: 210 frequency observations (two moduli each). Lines: existing Kelvin–Voigt fit in the 0.1–1 Hz primary band.
Mean whole-file held-out complex NRMSE: 0.498. The 1–10 Hz challenge is not used for calibration.
Source: Ruiz-Mateos Brea et al., Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.17413651 · Synthetic 3D geometry is not identified by these data.
